reviews.title: Use it if there weren’t too many ads
reviews.text: Before you read my review, please know that it’s free to download, but you have to pay to use. I want this app to customize my iPad, to make it unique. I saw a app and I was like I need this, but it is the worst app in the world. You have to watch so many ads for example I wanted the thing to customize the apps on your device. So I watched the ads.(by the way there are three of them I had to watch.) and then I finally got it. It gave me instructions to do and while I was doing those instructions, I forgot one of the steps. I didn’t even close the app and when I opened the app back again it made watch ANOTHER THREE ADS just to get the item back even though I already paid for it. After that, I was really tired of it so I gave up. I clicked the button that’s supposed to take you back to the home screen of the app. Guess what it made me watch ANOTHER AD just to get back to the home screen. I definitely do not recommend this app and please try A DIFFERENT APP TO CUSTOMIZE YOUR iPad.😡😡😡
